children: Turkey’s consumer confidence index rose to 91.9 in September 2026 from 90.8 in the previous month.

It marked the highest reading since July 2018, as expectations for households’ financial situation over the next 12 months improved to 93.7 from 93.1, while confidence in the general economic outlook rose to 89.8 from 89.4.
Consumers also showed a stronger willingness to make major purchases, with the index measuring intentions to spend on durable goods climbing to 108.8 from 105.1.
On the other hand, assessments of current household finances edged down to 75.3 from 75.4.
Despite the improvement in sentiment, the headline index remained below the neutral 100 mark, suggesting that consumers continued to hold a broadly pessimistic view of economic conditions.

title: Turkey Consumer Confidence at Over 8-Year High
